newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - May 12.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on May 12. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Supporters of the ousted leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI), Megawati Sukarnoputri, turned up at a large campaign rally organised by the rival Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP), on Sunday. Many of Megawati's supporters have crossed to the PPP in protest against the PDI's government-backed faction.
Indonesian and Canadian trade ministers agreed in Montreal over the weekend that the Busang debacle in Kalimantan should not disturb trade and investment relations between the two countries.

Some 400 people will lose their job this week at the Busang gold project in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province, where claims that the area contain the richest gold deposit found this century were found to be a massive hoax.
